requirements.title: Milestone boundary and invariant
requirements.summary: Doctor subscriptions and practice billing. Synthetic-only implementation; retain doctor ownership, independent secretary grants and separate patient identity/relationship/encounter; no clinical/legal/provider/commercial authority inferred.
requirements.provenance: Supplied roadmap v0.2 plus current delegated scope.

requirements.title: Doctor subscription and commercial-policy decisions
requirements.summary: Approve per-doctor plans, prices, trial, locations/staff limits, refunds and expiry; invent no commercial values. Acceptance: Obtain explicit per-doctor plan, price/currency, trial, staff/location quota, renewal, grace/expiry, refund and cancellation decisions without filling commercial values from another Suit. Define doctor as subscriber and secretary as independently invited staff; separate subscription entitlement from practice patient billing. Approve preservation/access behavior on expiry and downgrade; historical clinical/financial records are never deleted to enforce a plan. Prepare evidence for DOS-M6-GATE-COMMERCIAL. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-001 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Entitlement and usage enforcement
requirements.summary: Implement backend quotas/idempotency with clear read/write behavior and no historical record deletion on expiry. Acceptance: Evaluate entitlements and quota mutations server-side from trusted current subscription state, with atomic allocation and idempotency. Implement approved write/read/export behavior for trial, active, past-due, cancelled and expired states without erasing history or blocking safety-critical access by assumption. Return explicit entitlement errors and usage totals scoped to doctor practice; client metadata and hidden buttons cannot grant paid capabilities.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-002 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Subscription checkout or approved manual-payment process
requirements.summary: Use an approved payment route; never assume account/provider eligibility or reuse another product secret. Acceptance: Choose an approved checkout or manual-payment route with verified account eligibility, currencies, cost/refund terms and server credentials ownership. Create server-side quote/payment intent from approved price/version and doctor subscriber identity; browser totals/return URLs are untrusted. Use only sandbox or synthetic manual evidence; no account creation, charges, paid API or production callback activation is included. Prepare evidence for DOS-M6-GATE-PAYMENT. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-003 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Payment confirmation and reconciliation
requirements.summary: Use trusted payment evidence, duplicate-event handling and reconciliation; browser return is not authority. Acceptance: Accept payment confirmation only through verified provider evidence or approved audited manual review, bound to payment intent, amount/currency and subscriber. Persist duplicate/out-of-order event handling, idempotent entitlement update and reconciliation of pending/unknown outcomes. Verify callback authentication and replay protection; retain financial history and exclude sensitive payment data from logs.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-004 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Renewal, cancellation and subscription settings
requirements.summary: Provide auditable lifecycle changes and accurate doctor-facing billing state. Acceptance: Implement approved renewal/cancel/reactivate lifecycle with effective dates, current plan/version and explicit customer acknowledgement. Separate requested cancellation from effective expiry and provider confirmation; retain invoices/payment history and auditable changes. Show accurate current, pending and failed billing state, retry safely and preserve allowed record access under expiry policy.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-005 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Practice service prices and visit charges
requirements.summary: Define doctor/location services and patient charges separately from the SaaS subscription. Acceptance: Define doctor/location service price records and effective versions separately from SaaS plans; persist patient charge snapshot and currency. Authorize charge creation/correction with links to visit/service and accountable actor; later price changes never rewrite an existing charge. Use exact monetary arithmetic and explicit rounding/discount approval rules; tax applicability remains gated.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-006 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Collections, receipts and refunds
requirements.summary: Implement atomic patient-payment/receipt/refund flows with appropriate approvals and immutable financial history. Acceptance: Post patient collections, allocations, receipt numbers and refunds atomically with idempotency, exact amounts and approved authorization. Preserve immutable financial entries and link corrections/refunds to originals; no destructive edit/delete of paid history. Prevent over-allocation and over-refund under concurrency, record pending/unknown external outcomes and reconcile before retrying money movement.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-007 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Egypt tax-document applicability and adapter decision
requirements.summary: Obtain qualified applicability review and verify required official integration before any compliance claim. Acceptance: Obtain qualified current Egypt tax-document applicability review for the exact business model, entity and service types; do not infer exemption or obligation. Record any required official interface/version, enrollment, credentials custody, environment and legal invoice/receipt fields from verified sources. If applicable, specify separately approved adapter/test requirements; absent evidence prohibits compliance badges or production tax submissions. Prepare evidence for DOS-M6-GATE-TAX. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-008 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Revenue and settlement reporting
requirements.summary: Reconcile practice revenue, outstanding balances and SaaS billing views to their distinct ledgers. Acceptance: Reconcile practice charges/collections/refunds/outstanding balances to their own immutable entries, separately from SaaS invoices/settlements. Use explicit date/status/currency definitions, scoped full-population queries and stable trace links from every report total to source. Show pending settlements/refunds and discrepancies; never net different currencies or equate provider payout with patient revenue.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-009 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Financial and commercial acceptance
requirements.summary: Verify concurrency, reconciliation, refunds, entitlements and separately approved commercial launch policy. Acceptance: Verify plan/entitlement/checkout-confirmation/renewal and practice-charge/payment/refund/report journeys on the exact synthetic candidate. Obtain independent financial review of concurrency, rounding, reconciliation and required commercial/tax decisions. Record commercial launch as separately unapproved until actual owner/provider evidence exists; no real money or production billing is exercised here.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M6-010 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

transaction_contract: Verify exact Automation target, live function/schema/trigger fingerprints, immutable project ID, route, model, retry policy, command registrations and publication scopes before writes.

Acquire parent-reviewed transaction serialization lock and reread every scoped ID; existing equal payload is a no-op only after full canonical comparison; any differing state/history aborts. Never overwrite existing tasks, decisions, execution or requirement history.
Create or verify the real OPEN milestone start decision before any task; create every task through supported function and link every task to that decision with blocking=true in the SAME transaction.
Create all requirement, decision and dependency links and refresh contracts after final metadata. Do not commit partial task/link batches.

Assert exact payload counts, complete links, zero ready Doctor tasks using live ready-task predicate, zero claims/runs/executions, no publication authority, and all start decisions still OPEN immediately before commit.
Dry-run rollback and review returned evidence first. Parent controls any commit; never remove a guard from the original draft SQL.
After commit read back canonical packets and zero-ready evidence. Keep all nine start gates open until parent confirms all nine safely saved; release each milestone separately in dependency order.
pending_inputs: Parent live schema/consumer and trigger contract
Reviewed Doctor suit/workstream/app mapping (function requires active project/workstream)
Verified high-capability deep model and retry policy IDs
Approved command registration and protected publication paths
Exact no-ready-task SQL predicate and transaction/rollback proof

readback_assertions: All nine milestone start decisions remain open, including milestones not selected for implementation.
For every task, canonical_task_contract in stored metadata is deeply equal to the reviewed canonical task and canonical_task_sha256 matches.
Round-trip all supported top-level function arguments plus requirement/dependency/decision links; retain produced/informational decisions as blocking=false.
Compare shared project allowed_publication_paths to its locked pre-import value and require exact equality; no scope widening is part of registration.
Use the reviewed live ready-task predicate and require zero ready Doctor tasks before commit and after readback; no partial task batch may commit.
